verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own marketing says access can be scoped with roles down to the table and column, alongside SSO through your identity provider. That covers the role, table and column parts of the story. Nothing in the pack documents row-level policies or masking, and the claim is a single line with no in-depth docs. missing for 10: row-level security policies, column masking policies, detailed access-control documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration
